memory_definition: Memory is a query/read projection over authorized Source, Artifact/version, Assertion, Decision, Action, Event, Derivation, Feedback, Authorization, AuditEntry, and Link records. It is not a second authority for original content.

prohibited: copying original text into a second authoritative store
turning an inference into a person fact
using a feedback acknowledgement as execution evidence

trace_examples.question: Why does LifeOS currently show an understanding?

chain.role: separate fixed synthetic health self-report source
AI/algorithm understanding with exact input refs
read-model entry with links back to every prior node

trace_examples.failure_result: If any source, version, authorization, or evidence check fails, show evidence_unavailable or stale with the missing link; do not show a reliable understanding.

trace_examples.question: Why was this decision made?

chain.role: independent decision with rationale and status
supporting original content or stated fact

must_check: all previous nodes lawful and current

trace_examples.failure_result: A missing or revoked supporting item never erases Decision history, but the Memory detail must say evidence_unavailable/review_required and exclude it from automatic recommendation basis.

freshness_and_invalidation.effect: Derivation and Memory projection become stale; a new derivation must declare its exact new input set.
Memory retains a minimum historical reference only if authorized and labels the evidence gap; no reliable derived consumption.
active use is blocked before cleanup; dependent read projections become unavailable, stale, or review_required.
dependent confirmation effect is recalculated while append-only history remains visible.
deleted content cannot reappear through Memory, cache, export, backup, or a reconstructed projection.

read_model_rules.authoritative_writes: None. Memory writes no original content, no confirmation effect, and no authorization.
read_model_rules.rebuild: Allowed only from still-authorized, non-tombstoned, exact-version provenance; old derivation output remains historical or superseded rather than being relabeled as a new result.
read_model_rules.query_gate: Repository/query adapter returns candidate ids only; application service rechecks authorization, source, version, tombstone, generation, evidence, and Link validity before presenting an item.
